gen-almendra-display-gf-abeezee: ABeeZee keeps its terminals well clear of the stems, friendly and open. Under Almendra Display's ornate, literary heading, a long page of it would feel like smooth, easy conversation on a plain sans.
gen-almendra-display-gf-aldrich: Aldrich draws its round letters cupped rather than clenched, with an x-height rising close to the capitals. Almendra Display's ornate, literary heading sits above it, and long reading feels like following one thick thread.
gen-almendra-display-gf-alexandria: Alexandria opens its c terminals wide and stands tall. Beneath Almendra Display's ornate, literary heading, a long passage would move along cleanly, with short stems above and below keeping the sans tidy.
gen-almendra-display-gf-amiko: Chunky, crayon-tall lowercase with outward-pointing tongs. Amiko is the sans-serif workhorse here, while Almendra Display adds an ornate, literary flourish whose letters never seem to pinch shut.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-sanchez: Chubbo looks drawn with a marker tip, casual and inviting. Its smooth bends are what it does best, while Sanchez, a dignified text serif, handles the bookish, steadier voice with calipers-open c shapes.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-enriqueta: Literary and dignified, Enriqueta curves like chalk, stopping well before each shape closes. Oswald stands over it with confident, strong, tightly knit rows, and the serif below gives that muscle somewhere softer to land.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-work-sans: Friendly and tightly packed, Pramukh Rounded tips its open bowls toward you with large lowercase forms and little breathing gap. Work Sans keeps its c tips apart and reads smoothly onward.
gen-almendra-display-gf-anek-bangla: Letters that never seem to pinch shut give Almendra Display its ornate, literary face. Anek Bangla replies in sans with wide, barely curled s curves and a short climb from midline to ascender.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-dm-sans: DM Sans is friendly and approachable, with wide-set terminals on its s. Red Hat Display brings marker-like constant lines and visible daylight in every curve, while DM Sans stays a plain sans of softer, lower-key swelling.
